name: Dara Sok
action: Dara sets down the clipboard, makes a small tick beside the last entry, and straightens up slowly, pressing a hand to their knee. They look at the foreman and nod. "I can cover Dock 7. But the bay door there has a hydraulic leak—I noticed the stain on the concrete during my walks. Is anyone looking at it?"
reason: Dara interpreted the foreman's request to cover Dock 7 as a casual favor, but the tone reminded them of a demanding customs supervisor in Phnom Penh who expected compliance. Recognizing that this foreman had been fair and had left them to their counts, Dara felt unable to refuse without shirking their duty. Before agreeing, they marked their last count position—pallet 17—to avoid losing track. They also recalled the hydraulic leak they had noticed twice at Dock 7's bay door and chose to mention it as a practical precaution, not as a challenge.
